title: Pray Watch
description:
Pray Watch is a sleek, modern Islamic prayer app that provides accurate prayer times, adhan notifications, and qibla directions while being light on resources. Stay on top of your spiritual obligations with a customizable daily prayer schedule and a selection of traditional and modern adhan reciters.

Supporting multiple calculation methods like ISNA, Egyptian, Indonesian, Pakistani, Saudi Religious Authority and other, Pray Watch ensures alignment with your religious authority. The built-in compass accurately determines the qibla direction using GPS and sensors. 

Privacy is a human right, and we protect it. Pray Watch does not collect or store any user data. Everything stays securely on your device. Your worship is a private matter—free from surveillance, tracking, or risk of exposure. Your service to your Creator remains between you and Him.

100% free, no hidden fee, no adds, no distractions.

Download Pray Watch today on the App Store and Google Play!
